199.query: SELECT CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM event_BringtoLoadingBay e_bay JOIN event_object eo_c ON e_bay.ocel_id = eo_c.ocel_event_id JOIN object oc ON oc.ocel_id = eo_c.ocel_object_id AND oc.ocel_type = 'Container' JOIN event_object eo_lv_c ON oc.ocel_id = eo_lv_c.ocel_object_id JOIN event_LoadtoVehicle elv ON elv.ocel_id = eo_lv_c.ocel_event_id JOIN event_object eo_v ON elv.ocel_id = eo_v.ocel_event_id JOIN object ov ON ov.ocel_id = eo_v.ocel_object_id AND ov.ocel_type = 'Vehicle' JOIN event_object eo_dep ON ov.ocel_id = eo_dep.ocel_object_id JOIN event_Depart edep ON edep.ocel_id = eo_dep.ocel_event_id WHERE (strftime('%s', e_bay.ocel_time) + 48*3600) > strftime('%s', edep.ocel_time)) THEN 'SI' ELSE 'NO' END AS risposta;

200.query: SELECT CASE WHEN (AVG((strftime('%s', e2.ocel_time) - strftime('%s', e1.ocel_time)) / 3600.0) * 0.5) < 1.0 THEN 'SI' ELSE 'NO' END FROM event_PickUpEmptyContainer e1 JOIN event_object eo1 ON e1.ocel_id = eo1.ocel_event_id JOIN event_object eo2 ON eo1.ocel_object_id = eo2.ocel_object_id JOIN event_LoadtoVehicle e2 ON e2.ocel_id = eo2.ocel_event_id;
colonne: CASE WHEN (AVG((strftime('%s', e2.ocel_time) - strftime('%s', e1.ocel_time)) / 3600.0) * 0.5) < 1.0 THEN 'SI' ELSE 'NO' END
